item: An unreadable robots.txt no longer reads as robots-blocked on the Law table
summary: _verdict_of labelled every last_status mentioning robots as robots_blocked, including the fail-closed RobotsUnavailable refusal when robots.txt could not be read (401/403, 5xx, or no answer, which a DNS failure on the operator's own machine also gives): justice.gc.ca's unreachable robots.txt read as the publisher forbidding its documents. A new robots_unread verdict ('robots.txt not readable', x12), judged after an explicit disallow; the fetch is still refused and the stored message stays the hover. The 5 documents keeping 'Skip to main content'/'Cymraeg' are the boilerplate strip's stated, test-pinned limit (only markup-declared chrome is removed) and are left as is.
